root_motivation: ctrace session logs accumulate unrendered summaries because headless timer ticks are SIGKILLed by cgroup teardown before the SessionEnd hook fires. 623 of 1874 logs (33%) have no summary. There is no typed model of which logs are in debt, how old the debt is, or what to do about each. coda-sweep creates the corpus repo, shared types, and a pure sweep() function so subsequent sibling PRDs (coda-audit, coda-close) have a contract to extend.
user_persona: Joe Yen running daily self-review on this laptop; coda plan is a dashboard showing summary-debt at a glance, piped to head or jq without panicking.

acceptance_criteria.description: cargo build and cargo test succeed offline; a test asserts sweep makes zero store calls (operates only on passed &[RawLog] + active-log path + injected now/grace).
SessionLog, SummaryState, DebtClass, SweepAction, SweepPlan are public and serde-(de)serializable; a round-trip test covers each.
CodaConfig::load parses config/coda.example.toml yielding expected grace_secs + sessions_dir; absent file yields documented defaults.

sweep classifies correctly: active-log path → Active + NoOp (even if summary missing); missing-summary log younger than grace → Fresh + Skip; missing-summary log older than grace → Orphaned + Render; log with summary → Settled + NoOp.
coda plan --format json emits one entry per log plus SweepPlan tallies (orphaned/fresh/settled/total); schema matches documented SweepPlan.
coda plan exits non-zero when >=1 log is Orphaned, zero when none are; covered by two integration cases.
coda plan | head -1 does not panic (SIGPIPE reset verified by a test that closes the read end early).
README documents the config format, the type surface, and the LogStore trait so coda-audit/coda-close/coda-boot have a contract to extend.

scope: Shared Rust types: SessionLog, SummaryState, DebtClass, SweepAction, SweepPlan, RawLog
LogStore trait abstracting the sessions directory
Pure sweep(logs, active_log, now, grace) function
coda plan subcommand: table output + --format json
Exit code semantics: non-zero when any Orphaned log exists
non_goals: No --apply flag or actual rendering of summaries (that is coda-close)
No FsStore reading real ~/.cache/ctrace/sessions/ (that is coda-audit)
No scheduling, daemon mode, or watch loop
No integration with agorabus or any external bus
No migration or repair of existing bad summaries

additional.no_let_chains: MSRV 1.85 — no let-chains; use nested if-let or match instead
additional.sigpipe_reset: sigpipe::reset() must be first line of main()

five_whys_trace.q: Why do 623 ctrace logs have no summary?
five_whys_trace.a: The SessionEnd hook fires the scribe render command, but headless timer ticks are SIGKILLed by cgroup teardown before the hook runs.

five_whys_trace.q: Why hasn't this been fixed systematically?
five_whys_trace.a: There is no model of the debt — which logs need summaries, how old they are, what to do about each. Self-review re-derives the gap by hand each time and runs scribe backfill inconsistently.

five_whys_trace.q: Why isn't there a model of the debt?
five_whys_trace.a: No typed, testable representation has been built. The information is scattered: ndjson file count vs summary.md count, ctrace-scribe README notes, open docket item ctrace-sessionend-flake.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the model need to be typed and testable before anything else?
five_whys_trace.a: relay/concord/quicken/keel/anchor all failed when extend PRDs started without a shipped corpus repo. The classification logic, the type surface, and the LogStore trait must be immutable contracts before coda-audit and coda-close can extend them safely.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is the signal for Active vs Settled vs Orphaned — does NDJSON have an end marker?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Graceful logs don't carry an end marker either. Signal is purely: (a) path matches the active ctrace log, (b) .summary.md exists, (c) mtime age vs grace threshold. No NDJSON parsing needed.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does FakeStore need to implement LogStore::render?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: render is part of the trait but is unused in coda-sweep (no --apply). FakeStore::render can return Ok(()) unconditionally. The trait exists for coda-close to implement.
